field_changes.old: No major fixes or big changes to report, just tuning things up to keep the app running smoothly.
field_changes.new:
✅Fixed: Any saved meals Meals that included from My Foods or My Recipes would log 0 calories or disappear when you switched devices. Now your saved meals log correctly from any device.

✅For those using GLP-1 tools, pausing and resuming support would cause symptom tracking to be listed as “coming soon.” Now you can log your side effects the moment you resume support.

🐛 Bugs: great for the environment, bad for your logging experience.
*For all the latest fixes, update to the latest app version
